title: Murasu weakens into a depression; heavy rain in east Telangana
body: Deccan Chronicle: Murasu has weakened into a depression over Telangana and AP. Telangana Today: Mulakalapally logged 231.8 mm, and Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem saw extremely heavy rain, while Hyderabad stayed mostly overcast. Deccan Chronicle also reports a flash flood alert for Bhadradri Kothagudem. The News Minute reports 2 deaths and 312 damaged houses in Andhra Pradesh.
means: Khammam / Bhadradri Kothagudem: avoid causeways, streams and low-lying roads
Hyderabad: no heavy rain from this system; carry a light rain cover
care: Check your district's IMD warning before travelling today.

steps.b: Murasu crossed the Andhra coast and weakened into a depression.
Heaviest rain fell in Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem.
Watch IMD for any remaining rain and flood alerts.

steps.e: IMD landfall window, Nellore to Narsapur
Heaviest totals reported in east Telangana
